fields.finding: KNF inlet speed is read from the low-pressure curve, not its STP delivery rating. Installed speed is assumed 75% of nominal. E2M28 motor 750 W is mechanical; 1000 W electrical is an assumption. One E2M28 is 2.3% short of the Kapton hot constant-source envelope at the assumed installation factor.
fields.proposed_next: Measure effective inlet speed and input power with water vapour and the actual plumbing. Kapton needs at least 21.112 m3/h at the hot source-rate envelope.
